source: Route-bearing rows in 02-screen-specifications.md; non-route surfaces remain in prose.

screens.layout: Brand/context; welcome title; email/password; visibility control; Remember me; primary Login; signup link
screens.behavior: Preserve login validation, server errors, pending state, keyboard submission and session recovery. Do not expose password text by default.

screens.layout: Brand/context; business name, owner name and email; password/confirmation; create-account action; login link
screens.behavior: Preserve minimum-eight-character password and current validation. Show field-level and general errors without clearing values.

screens.layout: Sale header/cart count; search + scan; category filter drawer; product rows/cards with photo, name, stock, price options; cart continuation summary
screens.behavior: Add using correct price type; preserve selected quantities and draft while filtering. Show unavailable/out-of-stock/below-cost context from source. Offline cache readiness/sync context remains visible.

screens.layout: Back/title and line/unit count; one card per selected price line; quantity stepper, FOC field, pack/unit shortcut; line total; Continue
screens.behavior: Distinguish sold quantity from free quantity. Show stock and below-cost warnings at affected line. Remove is clearly labeled. Empty cart links back to product selection.

screens.layout: Back/title; confirmed customer selection; totals/discount; payment method and paid-now amount; balance/change; submit
screens.behavior: Require customer when credit remains according to source. Online/offline constraints must remain explicit. Disable duplicate checkout and keep draft on rejection. Omit the unsavable sale-note field.

screens.layout: Reference-mapped header/cart shortcut; retained-cart panel; one form panel; Cancel/Create customer
screens.behavior: Name and phone required in this checkout-specific form; optional email/address/customer note. Select created customer in Checkout without losing cart/payment. See the mapped reference and implementation record.

screens.layout: Back/title/menu; connection banner; four stored status counts; Sync now; latest/oldest sort; local receipt cards with amount, units/items, date, status and action menu; receipt preview
screens.behavior: Follow mapped references 005 and 144. Separate pending, syncing, conflict and completed states. Sync actions use the existing waiting queue; disable sync offline and retain failed records for explicit retry. Preserve canonical local receipt IDs, source draft and list sort on Back. Never call a local sale server-confirmed before sync.

screens.layout: Reference 006: Back/title/Add; two inventory summaries; search/scan + filter; count/export/tools; compact photo/name/SKU/stock/primary-price cards; shared bottom navigation
screens.behavior: Category/stock filters remain in the right drawer. Tools retains refresh, import and barcode selection. Stock status includes text; below-cost warning remains. No product-detail route is invented.

screens.layout: References 007–009: Basic photo/identity/base-unit form; Inventory identity/conversion/stock/cost/threshold; Prices manual/automatic cards; pinned Cancel/Previous/Continue/Save product
screens.behavior: Wait for configured pricing rules before initialization. Preserve values/photo across steps and route return. Currency follows the active business. Shared automatic markup/rounding remain read-only; per-product mode/price remain editable.

screens.layout: References 010–012: photo panel and identity/description fields; inventory profile + unit/conversion/stock/cost panels; price-step profile above progress and price cards
screens.behavior: Description uses supported online_description. Unit-size metadata is unsupported and omitted. SKU/category remain optional. Product-name and description limits follow the API. Busy saves disable form editing and guard duplicate submissions; failures retain draft and target the failing step.

screens.layout: Reference 013: Back/title/menu; product photo/stock/price; Add stock/Remove stock; quantity/unit, resulting balance, reason and Save adjustment; dated movement rows
screens.behavior: Direction determines the signed API adjustment; prevent zero/nonfinite or negative resulting stock. Retain reason/quantity on failure. Refresh affected stock/history after success; preserve source search/list state on ordinary Back.

screens.layout: Title + New purchase; summary/context; search + date/filter drawer + export; purchase rows with supplier/reference/date/total/payment context
screens.behavior: Separate row navigation from overflow actions. Keep filtered history and scroll when returning.

screens.layout: Four-step wizard: Basic information; Select products; Quantities and costs; Review and submit
screens.behavior: Step 1 supplier/reference; step 2 searchable/category product selection; step 3 buying unit, conversion, paid quantity, FOC, cost; step 4 totals, payment/paid-now and note. Preserve draft between steps.

screens.layout: Same wizard with existing purchase and edit context
screens.behavior: Explain resulting stock/account changes through existing rules; validate all lines before saving.

screens.layout: Back/reference; supplier/date/payment summary; purchased item cards; totals; actions
screens.behavior: Supplier navigation when permitted; edit/delete actions visible as authorized; unknown/deleted purchase recovery.

screens.layout: Title; period/search/filter/export; totals with clear scope; sale rows with receipt/customer/date/amount and payment state
screens.behavior: Shared transaction/history infrastructure remains in use; keep sales context in labels and return paths.

screens.layout: Back/receipt; sale total and paid/balance; customer/payment/date; item list; totals/discount; receipt and authorized edit/delete
screens.behavior: Receipt printing is a separate operation from changing sale. Keep print progress/failure local.

screens.layout: Two-step Cart and Checkout; selected items/prices/quantities/FOC, then customer/payment/discount and authorization
screens.behavior: Preserve stock/account reconciliation, price type, original receipt identity and protected-edit/PIN flow. Keep errors by field/line and bring validation into view. The API has no payment-note field.

screens.layout: Title + Add; search/filter/export; compact customer contact rows with name/contact left and balance state right
screens.behavior: This is the presentation reference for shop customer rows. Receivable/payable/settled use text as well as semantic color.

screens.layout: Customer identity/contact form; grouped optional details; Cancel/Save
screens.behavior: Name, phone, optional email, address/note according to existing form; return to actual caller.

screens.layout: Same form with existing identity
screens.behavior: Preserve source detail/list state; report validation without wiping values.

screens.layout: Customer profile/contact; receivable/payable summary; Add payment, statement print and edit actions; tabs Credit sales / Payment records
screens.behavior: Search history and date drawer belong to active history. Preserve tab/query/page/scroll. Show account direction clearly.

screens.layout: Account identity/balance context; direction; amount; payment method; note; submit
screens.behavior: Explicitly label customer pays shop vs shop pays customer. Do not rely on signed numbers alone.

screens.layout: Same payment form populated with current record
screens.behavior: Preserve audit/business rules, financial confirmation and required PIN. Cancel returns to correct account/history.

screens.layout: Title + Add; search/filter/export; contact rows and payable/account summary
screens.behavior: Match customer directory density while retaining supplier-specific labels and direction.

screens.layout: Supplier name, phone/contact person, address/note; Cancel/Save
screens.behavior: Keep existing optional/required rules; retain caller context from purchases if used.

screens.layout: Same form with current supplier
screens.behavior: Validation and missing record states.

screens.layout: Contact summary; account balance; pay/statement/edit; Purchases and Payment records tabs; history filters
screens.behavior: Distinguish shop owes supplier from supplier owes shop. Keep tab/date/query and loaded rows on return.

screens.layout: Supplier/account context; movement direction, amount/method/note; confirm
screens.behavior: Shop pays supplier vs supplier pays shop must be readable.

screens.layout: Same populated payment form
screens.behavior: Reconcile affected balances/history after server success.

screens.layout: Title + Add; today/month/filtered summary with period labels; search/filter/export; expense rows
screens.behavior: Date/category/payment filters and presets in drawer; top-category context must identify scope.

screens.layout: Date, title/category, amount/payment method, note; Cancel/Save
screens.behavior: Numeric keyboard, clear currency, inline validation.

screens.layout: Same populated form with record context
screens.behavior: Keep source filters/scroll; missing record and save failure recovery.

screens.layout: Title; Customers / Suppliers tabs; search/date/filter/export; scoped totals; movement cards
screens.behavior: Each row names party, direction, method, date, amount and reference. Switching tabs keeps context coherent; sales history is its own module.

screens.layout: Party/record context; direction/amount/method/note; Cancel/Save
screens.behavior: Use shared payment edit rules while returning to the transaction origin.

screens.layout: Equivalent supplier payment form
screens.behavior: Keep supplier-specific direction/copy and API behavior.

screens.layout: Title; date period/filter/export; net profit; sales/paid/credit/expense/FOC metrics; cash movement; inventory/account snapshots; month/year sales trends; payment breakdown; top products; expense categories
screens.behavior: Keep period activity separate from current inventory valuation and outstanding balances. Explain the applicable date/as-of values. Chart values need readable alternatives.

screens.layout: Current plan/status/validity; latest payment; available package cards; payment account availability; billing history/export; support contacts
screens.behavior: Distinguish trial, valid paid, expired and pending approval. Selected plan has clear price/duration from server.

screens.layout: Selected plan summary; payment account/instructions; transfer proof picker; reference/note/message; submit
screens.behavior: Plan ID is numeric in current routing. JPG/PNG/WebP proof, max 5MB. Show preview/replace/upload error. Explain office approval; submission does not instantly activate the plan.

screens.layout: Title/context; Roles / Staff tabs; Add action; rows with role/permission summary or staff identity/status; secondary export
screens.behavior: Owner/authorized access only. Keep current user and protected roles/staff restrictions obvious.

screens.layout: Role name; grouped page access selection; Cancel/Create
screens.behavior: Require at least one allowed page according to source. No vague “all access” styling when only partial access is granted.

screens.layout: Same role form with assigned permissions
screens.behavior: Preserve backend permission identities and dependent constraints.

screens.layout: Name/email; role selection; active status; password/confirmation; Create
screens.behavior: Current password rule: minimum eight characters; do not expose existing passwords.

screens.layout: Identity, role and active status
screens.behavior: Password reset is its own route; prevent confusing role save with password update.

screens.layout: Staff identity; new password + confirmation; reset action
screens.behavior: Minimum eight characters, clear busy/success/failure; never put password in a summary or toast.

screens.layout: Title; grouped identity/business, output/device, administration and help rows
screens.behavior: Permission-aware rows. Staff currently have account/receipt/printer/barcode/about only; do not expose owner tools through styling.

screens.layout: Current identity; profile fields; current password; optional new password/confirmation; Save
screens.behavior: Current password required for profile changes under existing logic. Sensitive input is not retained in visible summaries.

screens.layout: Business name/title/contact/address/currency; logo preview/picker; Save
screens.behavior: Shared business identity affects other modules/storefront. Logo JPG/PNG/WebP max512KB. Explain shared effect where relevant.

screens.layout: Content visibility toggles; footer/alignment; paper/layout/font/margins; live preview; save/test print
screens.behavior: Preserve 50/58/80/85mm, A5/A4 choices and template behavior. Preview updates must not jump form scroll. Separate template settings from device printer profile.

screens.layout: Format selector; physical dimensions/margins/gaps; name/value toggles; live sample; Save/print where supported
screens.behavior: Formats: A4 3x8 / 4x10; rolls 40x30, 50x30, 60x40; custom sheet/roll. Label dimensions are physical mm, not CSS pixel suggestions. Invalid geometry needs inline errors.

screens.layout: Native/browser context; connection type; conditional setup; paper/copies/cut/color/orientation; connection/test actions; Save
screens.behavior: Native system/TCP/Bluetooth Classic; browser fallback explains printing path. Host/port for TCP; paired device selection and pairing help for Bluetooth. Preserve test progress/error.

screens.layout: Existing method rows; add/remove; save footer
screens.behavior: Preserve validation and method names used by transactions. Avoid accidental row deletion on field focus.

screens.layout: Price rows with manual/automatic rule and usage; Add/Edit/Delete
screens.behavior: Used types may be protected. Display automatic cost markup and rounding meaning.

screens.layout: Identity; manual/automatic mode; markup/rounding/min profit; Save
screens.behavior: Automatic-only fields disabled meaningfully in manual mode.

screens.layout: Same form; usage count; explicit Apply to existing option
screens.behavior: Applying to existing products replaces calculated prices; preserve explicit opt-in and explain effect. URL-encode names.

screens.layout: PIN status; PIN configuration/update form; Save
screens.behavior: Preserve optional PIN protection; never render stored PIN in plaintext.

screens.layout: Backup status/download; restore entry; visually separated danger reset entry
screens.behavior: Paid-plan gating for backup/restore; show trial restriction and Billing path. Export failure does not remove local/server data.

screens.layout: Prominent replacement consequence; `.mkpos-backup` picker; typed RESTORE; PIN if enabled; Restore
screens.behavior: Max25MB; preserve server validation, long-running busy behavior and identity/cache refresh after success. No real restore during design QA.

screens.layout: What is removed/preserved; safety backup explanation; typed RESET; optional PIN; destructive action
screens.behavior: Second confirmation sheet required by current flow. Preserve account/users/roles/subscription/billing; clear operational data only through server rules. Never execute in production for a visual check.

screens.layout: English / Myanmar choices and clear active state
screens.behavior: Apply existing global localization behavior, preserve source navigation and mixed-script data.

screens.layout: App version/runtime/server context; support/contact links
screens.behavior: Distinguish browser/PWA/native build context; do not expose secrets.

screens.layout: Workspace/title/context; compact management rows with icon, title, description, chevron
screens.behavior: Orders, Customers, Chat, Reviews, Report, Catalog, Promotions, Contacts, Delivery, Methods, Storefront, Fulfillment, Cover; owner logo/location entries. Filter by permissions and subscription.

screens.layout: Saved status/coordinates/time; public-location explanation and GPS update; expandable help; separate denied screen
screens.behavior: References 072/154; owner-only GPS, retry without invented coordinates, retained source and required setup gate. Missing location blocks staff until the owner acts.

screens.layout: Title; search/filter/export toolbar; result count/context; shared OrderCard list; endless footer
screens.behavior: Drawer: order/payment status, dates/timezone, request-only state and existing controls. No always-open date strip.

screens.layout: Back/reference; total/item count/state hero; fulfillment roadmap; icon+label action tiles; customer and fulfillment panels; requests; items/totals/promotions; linked POS sale; payment/proof/account; audit
screens.behavior: Distinct customer and delivery/pickup icon language. Clear optional sections. Preserve cross-module permissions on customer/sale links.

screens.layout: Same order context with focused action confirmation modal/form
screens.behavior: Normal detail actions open a modal without unnecessary navigation. Deep links must remain usable and close/back safely.

screens.layout: Full-page order summary; request type/reason/photo; decision radio cards; required review note; pinned Save decision/Cancel
screens.behavior: Preserve accept/reject rules, required reasons, pending state and record reconciliation.

screens.layout: Title; search/filter/export or bulk controls as present; product rows with stock/online price/publication; bulk Publish/Unpublish
screens.behavior: Drawer for category, stock, publication, online-price and sort controls. Bulk filtered action affects all matching records, not just visible rows; confirm filter scope/count.

screens.layout: Product identity; public product/unit/description/price/publication fields from source; preview context; Save
screens.behavior: Distinguish inventory fields from public publication fields; retain validation, missing record and subscription restriction.

screens.layout: Title; compact search/filter/export; contact-style customer rows; pagination
screens.behavior: Name/contact left, purchase badge/summary right, chevron. No oversized avatar, left accent stripe or decorative footer. Distinguish account/guest/blocked and optional contact information.

screens.layout: Back/customer identity; profile/contact/state; compact actions; purchase statistics by currency; order history heading/toolbar; shared OrderCard rows
screens.behavior: Preserve currency separation; no combined total across currencies. History filters and scroll survive order/chat navigation. Customer keys can represent account or guest and must be URL-encoded.

screens.layout: Customer context; current block state; explicit Block/Unblock confirmation and reason if provided by flow
screens.behavior: Busy/error keeps context. Permission-aware; never silently block on opening detail.

screens.layout: Buyer identity; existing/new credit contact context from source; explicit confirmation
screens.behavior: Reuse/link intentionally; no automatic financial balance creation or matching solely by name.

screens.layout: Title; compact search/unread filter drawer; avatar/name/last-message/time rows; unread and presence cues
screens.behavior: Entire conversation row opens thread. Long preview truncates without hiding identity/time. Empty inbox differs from no unread matches.

screens.layout: Full-page white header: Back, clickable avatar+name, presence; neutral message canvas; date/history states; bottom composer
screens.behavior: UUID is a 36-character thread key. Hide outer app header/trial banner only here. Profile group opens buyer detail. No separate placeholder-profile icon. Preserve true origin on Back.

screens.layout: Title/context; search/filter/export; compact summaries Matching reviews / Awaiting reply shown; review cards; endless footer
screens.behavior: Drawer: shop/product type, rating, reply status, content, dates and sort from source. The shown awaiting count describes loaded rows only.

screens.layout: Review/customer/rating/target context; existing reply; clearly labeled public reply textarea; Cancel/Save
screens.behavior: Process permission required to reply. Max2,000 characters; blank removes existing reply. Explain removal before saving blank content. Keep source list filters/scroll.

screens.layout: Title; period/currency/filter/export; summary and previous-period comparisons; daily chart/table; product/buyer/outcome/origin/segment breakdowns; payment/refund/fulfillment and customer follow-up
screens.behavior: Currency and resolved date range are required context. Reset stages valid initial dates/currency; Apply is explicit. No cross-currency total. Show comparison absence honestly instead of infinite percent growth.

screens.layout: Title + New coupon/New flash sale; search/filter; selected count and bulk actions when selected; promotion rows with type/status/schedule/discount
screens.behavior: Selection persists across filter/page changes as implemented. Select loaded vs select matching scope must be explicit. Preserve max1,000 selected constraint.

screens.layout: Identity/code; percent/fixed discount; minimum subtotal/usage limits; enabled/schedule; review/save
screens.behavior: Clearly show discount units/currency; optional limits distinct from zero. Use business timezone.

screens.layout: Identity/schedule; product picker; per-product discount and quantity limits; Save
screens.behavior: Up to100 product rows; used product restrictions remain visible. Product removal and price edits have clear row targets.

screens.layout: Matching coupon/flash-sale form with existing usage/state context
screens.behavior: Lock used/restricted fields according to source; do not silently reset history/limits.

screens.layout: Title + Add; compact platform/contact rows; edit/delete actions; count/limit
screens.behavior: Current maximum100. Platform icon is meaningful and paired with label/value.

screens.layout: Platform; label; value; Save
screens.behavior: Platforms include phone/email/Facebook/TikTok/YouTube/Telegram/Viber/Instagram/WhatsApp. Preserve platform-specific validation.

screens.layout: Same form populated
screens.behavior: Encoded identity and missing-record recovery.

screens.layout: Title + Add; option name/fee rows and actions
screens.behavior: Current maximum100; clear currency and zero-fee meaning.

screens.layout: Option name and fee; Save
screens.behavior: Validate fee with current rules.

screens.layout: Same form populated
screens.behavior: Preserve references from existing orders.

screens.layout: Reference 098: title/Add, explanation/count, cash/bank cards, receiving summary, manual/active state, overflow Edit/Delete
screens.behavior: Maximum 20; masked summary/full editable account; guarded deletion and last-active validation. Separate from POS payment labels.

screens.layout: Reference 099: name, payment-type radio cards, receiving-details card, instructions/count, active switch; fixed Cancel/Save method
screens.behavior: Preserve Cash/transfer drafts, custom bank/wallet names, optional receiving details and supported 2,000-character instructions. Natural scrolling.

screens.layout: Reference 100: same populated sections with Save changes
screens.behavior: Preserve full account values, inline validation, retry, unique retained IDs and source Back state; existing orders retain their payment snapshot.

screens.layout: Public URL/slug and identity context; online price type; description; storefront/accepting-orders/marketplace options; announcement; opening hours/temporary closure; Save
screens.behavior: Shared business fields and owner restrictions remain enforced. Slug is locked after orders exist. Use labeled switches with consequence text. Show public URL as a link with correct target.

screens.layout: Pickup address/hours, buyer instructions, live buyer preview; fixed Save changes
screens.behavior: Reference 102; blank address falls back to shop address, hours are descriptive, instructions retain the supported 2,000-character limit. New pickup orders snapshot the saved details.

screens.layout: Current cover/empty preview; upload requirements; choose/replace/remove; Save
screens.behavior: PNG/JPG/WebP, max2MB and4800x4800px under current UI requirements; preserve preview vs persisted state and upload errors. Preview scales without stretching.

screens.layout: Square shared-logo preview; business identity explanation; owner note; requirements; Replace/Remove; fixed Cancel/Save
screens.behavior: Reference 104; PNG/JPG/WebP up to 512 KB and 2400 × 2400 px. Stage removal until Save, support Undo/retry and retain selected files through Back/Forward.
